snippet.title: Twofold Tower – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Solve 1000+ handcrafted puzzles, and ponder a philosophical narrative set in the ruins of a broken fantasy world. Outwit monsters, manipulate time and space, and transcend your all-too-human limits – or go mad trying…

Wishlist the game on Steam today, and feel free to join the Digitemenos Discord server for a chat!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4371430/Twofold_Tower/
Website: https://www.digitemenos.com/twofold-tower
Discord: https://discord.gg/SarXPNxU2b
